required_review_dimensions.description: Exact successful Slice 7 result and completion evidence remain self-hash and lineage bound before remote delivery.
The tested terminal transport crosses a real loopback HTTP request/response boundary rather than direct in-process invocation.
Remote idempotency key is platform-derived from exact terminal execution identity/binding and caller replacement or rebinding fails closed.
Failure before remote acceptance produces no remote effect and exact retry may apply once.
Remote commit before acknowledgment is represented as ambiguous rather than falsely completed.
Timeout after remote commit cannot directly mint successful completion evidence.
Explicit retry/reconciliation recovers the durable remote receipt without applying a second effect.
Remote/client durable state survives restart and reconciliation remains one-effect.
Concurrent identical HTTP deliveries converge to one remote effect/result lineage.
Remote response cannot widen action/target/project/task/effect/state binding.
Structured failure or missing/malformed receipt cannot mint successful remote completion evidence.
Successful remote receipt is deterministically integrity-bound and exact-binding checked.
Completion evidence binds remote idempotency key, lineage, receipt digest/receipt, and deterministic completion hash.
Model/caller/service self-report cannot replace valid Slice 7 evidence or valid remote receipt.
No result claims real GitHub/cloud/deployment/release remote side effect occurred.
Accepted Slice 1 through Slice 7 boundaries remain green on the exact candidate.
Adversarial search finds no retry, ambiguity, idempotency, response, concurrency, restart, or false-green bypass within scope.
